game.title: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition
game.blurb: Party-based fantasy role-playing game on the Sword Coast, a remake of the 1998 original, from BioWare, Beamdog and Overhaul Games, released 2012-11-28. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: RPG, Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: From Candlekeep and the Friendly Arm to the bandits and the city of Baldur's Gate, with many quests on the way. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: The Korlasz Tomb and the Crusade
chapters.summary: After the city: the Korlasz family tomb, the coalition camp, the crusade, Ashatiel, Julann and the final battle. Spoiler-guarded where hidden.

chapters.title: Side Quests on the Road
chapters.summary: Optional tasks such as the Coast Way refugees, Takos's heirlooms, Glint's family, Halasan's recruits, Tsolak, the menhirs and the Terrible Trivium.

chapters.title: Party and Companions
chapters.summary: Party line-ups such as Neera, Dorn and Rasaad together, and reuniting with old friends.

chapters.title: Challenge Runs and Difficulty
chapters.summary: Solo runs, Legacy of Bhaal and Story Mode difficulty, and finishing with no deaths or a party of dead allies.

chapters.title: Character Feats
chapters.summary: Grand Master, high attributes, Armor Class and Hit Points, reputation, kill counts, Lore, fallen paladins and odd spell combinations.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 228280)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Baldur's_Gate
Fandom (baldursgate.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://baldursgate.fandom.com/wiki/Baldur's_Gate:_Enhanced_Edition
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition". The original game's page, "Baldur's Gate", is at completion stage 0: only "Prologue: Candlekeep" (about 2,000 characters) and "Table of Contents" (about 860) exist, while the Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls and "Chapter 1" to "Chapter 7" pages are linked but not created, so nothing was used. baldursgate.fandom.com answers the API, with about 22 linked pages, including "Siege of Dragonspear", "Baldur's Gate: Tales of the Sword Coast", "Neera", "Dorn Il-Khan" and "Rasaad yn Bashir"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 86 of 129 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions. Achievements 72 to 129 mention the Korlasz family tomb, a crusade, a coalition camp, Ashatiel and Julann; RAWG says the Enhanced Edition added "an expansion pack" and Fandom links "Siege of Dragonspear", so these are probably that expansion, but no achievement uses its name, so the chapter is named after the places. The 44 hidden achievements from number 61 onward ("An Ancient Evil" and "The End of Korlasz" first) were placed in that chapter by name because of their schema position next to the Korlasz and crusade ones; that is a judgement call. The other 42 hidden ones sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, though many (for example "Save the Cow!", "Fishermen's Friend", "Master Thief") are probably side quests. Whether app 228280 includes the expansion was not checked. RAWG lists a playtime of only 4 hours, which looks low.
